prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in steps consistently hurt performance across multiple tests, triggering guardrail rollbacks.
Finish screen layout changes consistently degraded performance, causing negative impacts and rollbacks.
Sign-in hints and adoption new screens proved helpful, driving multiple winning tests.
Home wait-info features mostly showed no clear effect across repeated tests, despite driving two winning tests.
Evidence remains mixed for adoption and choose-path redesigns, which yielded both significant wins and major losses.
Predictions were systematically too optimistic for failing changes and underestimated the gains of winning tests.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] new_pet_preview_style_screen: Insert a new screen before certificate creation that displays animated previews of the pet style. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results, leading to adoption drop-off.)
1: [choose_path, redesign] choose_path_carousel_redesign: Redesign the choose path screen into a full carousel showing path benefits side-by-side. (why: The choose_path step has a long mean duration of 514s, indicating confusion during path selection.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] upload_photos_interactive_preview_new_flow: Add an interactive validation photo flow on the photo upload screen with immediate preview feedback. (why: Custom pet rendering issues caused support tickets and drop-off during the adoption stage.)
3: [sign_in, redesign] sign_in_split_layout_redesign: Rebuild sign-in screen into a split layout separating cloud backup benefits from authentication options. (why: 8 emails reported pets missing or reset after re-authenticating, showing account confusion on sign-in.)
4: [sign_in, hint] sign_in_existing_pet_recovery_hint: Add a prominent hint explaining that signing into a previous account restores saved pets. (why: 8 support emails cited lost pets after signing in again, making account recovery assurance essential.)
5: [home, wait_info] waiting_desktop_render_status_hint: Show estimated rendering time and display tips while waiting for the pet to land on desktop. (why: 3 emails mentioned pets failing to show on desktop, while home step wait mean is 2336 seconds.)
6: [finish, hint] home_intro_desktop_summon_guide_hint: Add an explicit hint detailing hotkeys and right-click actions for controlling the pet. (why: 3 support tickets highlighted post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
7: [choose_path, hint] story_quick_overview_journey_hint: Include a setup time expectation hint on the story welcome screen. (why: Users spend up to 514s mean time on choose_path due to lack of initial process length clarity.)
8: [home, notification] waiting_pet_launch_notification: Enable optional desktop notifications when the pet setup finishes during long wait times. (why: High median wait time (201s) leads users to navigate away before the desktop pet appears.)
